skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental issues of Vietnamese financial law, distinguish between public and private financial law, and comprehend the sources and basic institutions of public financial law.
Demonstrate ability to search for information and legal regulations.
Apply skills to analyze, synthesize information, and resolve legal situations.
Apply skills to work effectively in a team.
Apply skills to communicate, present, and deliver presentations effectively.
Demonstrate ability to independently research, accumulate knowledge, and experience to enhance professional expertise.
